summary.business_type: Agency / professional services (boutique branding consultancy, Bogotá, Colombia)
top_findings: Team section shows a placeholder: 'Juliana Cabrera' five times with five roles
Headings lose their word spaces in raw HTML ('Creatingtoshapetheworld.')
Intro loader waits for 8 full-size photos (~3.1 MB): mobile LCP 20.9s in lab
No long-term caching on any asset, including hashed /_next/static files
No off-site footprint (no Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, directories, sameAs)
quick_wins: Add public/_headers: immutable caching for /_next/static/* plus basic security headers
Put real spaces between word spans in animated headings
Replace the five placeholder team cards with one real founder card
Delete out/styleguide after build so it returns a real 404
Convert about/portrait.png and belief/*.png to WebP and drop the below-fold preloads

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: http and www 301 to https apex
Real 404 with noindex for unknown URLs

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: No CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy on any response.
findings.recommendation: Add public/_headers with nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin and Permissions-Policy. HSTS later.

findings.title: Hashed assets not cached
findings.description: /_next/static/* and images return Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate.
findings.recommendation: _headers: /_next/static/* max-age=31536000, immutable; image folders a long max-age.

findings.title: /styleguide/ is a soft 404
findings.description: Returns 200 with a 'Page not found' body and noindex.
findings.recommendation: Remove out/styleguide in the production build so the 404 page handles it.

findings.title: Duplicate robots meta on 404
findings.description: 404 page has both 'noindex' and 'noindex, nofollow', and og:url points to the home page.
findings.recommendation: Emit one robots tag and drop og:url on the 404.

findings.title: Small leftovers
findings.description: 307 for slash-less URLs (Workers), og:type website on cases, deprecated Host: line in robots.txt, no IndexNow.
findings.recommendation: Optional: og:type article for cases, drop Host:, add an IndexNow key.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Eight case bodies are genuinely distinct (max 1.8% overlap)
Real named clients, six link to live sites

findings.title: Placeholder team
findings.description: 'Juliana Cabrera' appears five times with roles Strategy/Design/Research/Copy/Direction (lib/home-content.ts).
findings.recommendation: Show the real team, or one founder card for Juliana Cabrera Bonilla with a short bio and Person schema.

findings.title: No proof in case studies
findings.description: No year, client quote or measurable outcome on any case.
findings.recommendation: Add a facts row (year, client, country, scope) and one client quote or result per case.

findings.title: No service pages
findings.description: Naming, strategy and rebranding queries have no landing page. Verbo created the Albora, Altalba, Lienzo, Autip and Lukatto names.
findings.recommendation: Start with a Naming page, then Brand strategy and Real-estate branding.

findings.title: No outside authority signals
findings.description: No awards, press, directories or social profiles.
findings.recommendation: Create LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, Behance and Clutch/Sortlist profiles.

findings.title: Home copy rendered twice
findings.description: Desktop and mobile versions of projects and services are both in the HTML: 2,217 words, about 1,100 unique.
findings.recommendation: Render one version and adapt it with CSS where possible.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles and descriptions on all pages
Every page reachable from internal links

findings.title: Headings lose word spaces
findings.description: Raw HTML: H1 'Creatingtoshapetheworld.', H2 'Averbdoesnotdescribe.Itacts.', footer H2 'yoursdeserves' on every page.
findings.recommendation: Insert a space text node between word spans in the split-text components.

findings.title: Home H1 contains the CTA and no topic term
findings.description: H1 text includes 'Schedule a free discovery session'; no 'branding' or 'Bogotá'.
findings.recommendation: Move the CTA out of the H1.

findings.title: Case and /work/ titles carry no search terms
findings.description: 'Work - Verbo', 'Albora, case study - Verbo'.
findings.recommendation: For example 'Branding projects in Colombia - Verbo', 'Albora - residential brand naming and identity - Verbo'.

findings.title: Case H1 is a slogan
findings.description: For example 'From the field to your table' instead of 'Berry House'.
findings.recommendation: Keep the slogan visually but make the project name part of the H1.

findings.title: Thin organization node
findings.description: No telephone, areaServed or contactPoint.
findings.recommendation: Add telephone +57 318 346 0278, areaServed, contactPoint and alternateName 'Verbo Brands'.

findings.title: Thin CreativeWork
findings.description: No @id, mainEntityOfPage, dateCreated or client.
findings.recommendation: Add @id and mainEntityOfPage; add a year field in Sanity for dateCreated.

findings.title: No founder Person
findings.description: Nothing names who runs Verbo.
findings.recommendation: Add a Person node for the founder once the About section is real.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Case pages serve AVIF srcset with blur placeholders

findings.title: Intro loader blocks LCP
findings.description: Lab: home LCP 20.9s mobile / 5.3s desktop; the loader decodes 8 untransformed 2500px Sanity JPEGs (about 3.1 MB).
findings.recommendation: Request them at 800-1200w with auto=format, preload only the first, and gate the loader on the first frame.

findings.title: Close-section plates are heavy
findings.description: About 2.3 MB on desktop for plates shown at 160-220px.
findings.recommendation: Cap generated widths near 480px.

findings.title: Case LCP tied to the reveal animation
findings.description: Mobile 4.6s with 1.7s render delay; the hero AVIF is only 75 KB.
findings.recommendation: Make the first case image eager and high priority, with no opacity-0 start.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI crawlers get 200 and server-rendered HTML
Agent-friendliness check 91/100; the menu dialog is accessible

findings.title: robots.txt vs terms on AI training
findings.description: The terms forbid AI training; robots.txt allows GPTBot, CCBot, Google-Extended and others.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision: block training crawlers only and add Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no, or soften the terms.

findings.title: CTA links nameless until scrolled
findings.description: underline-link.tsx hides labels with autoAlpha 0, so 'Get to know us' and 'Meet the team' have no accessible name at load.
findings.recommendation: Animate opacity only (no visibility), or add an aria-label.

findings.title: Brand name inconsistency
findings.description: 'Verbo' in titles and schema, 'Verbo Brands' in copy; 'Verbo' collides with the Spanish word.
findings.recommendation: Use 'Verbo Brands' as alternateName and in key copy.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Alt text on all content images
Width and height set, no layout shift

findings.title: Oversized PNGs in public/
findings.description: about/portrait.png is 795 KB at 605x908; belief/sequence-1/2/3.png are 143-280 KB and preloaded though below the fold.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP/AVIF and remove the preloads.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Move the CTA out of the home H1
Styleguide real 404 and a single robots tag on the 404

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: WebP for the portrait and belief images; cap plate widths
Case facts row, project-name H1, keyword titles
Schema: telephone, areaServed, CreativeWork @id and dates
Decide the AI-training policy in robots.txt

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, Behance, Clutch/Sortlist; then sameAs
Naming service page, then strategy and real-estate branding
Client quotes and results on cases

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: PageSpeed Insights / CrUX once traffic exists
Re-run /seo audit after each phase; set a drift baseline
